The PbS (Se) bulk thin film is preferably deposited via liquid-phase method, i.e., chemical bath deposition (CBD), which was utilized since the 1930 s and remains widely employed in high-performance commercial PbS photoconductor products [42–44]. The chemical bath deposition of PbS thin film is carried out at room temperature, denoting the potential for monolithic integration. However, due to the lack of precisely controlled chemical bath deposition, the large-scale and high-yield production of low defect density PbS (Se) thin film photodetectors is limited [49–51].
